text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock A and Stock E after gains, but that may have cut short further upside; I should base sells on my plan, not just a quick rise.","Selling at a profit did not prevent my account value from falling, so I should judge decisions by the whole portfolio and its risk, not by realized gains alone.","I tend to hold declining stocks; I should review them as carefully as winners and be willing to sell when the original reasons for holding no longer apply."]}
